subject: Brannoc Ironvein
---

## Identity

A dwarf smith of Emberfall who keeps his forge cold after his apprentice vanished. [ch 001 / entry]

## History with the Party

- Explains why the forge is cold. [ch 001 / 001.01]
- Gives the party his apprentice's hammer and points them north. [ch 002 / 002.02]

## Notable Quotes

> "A forge is a promise, and mine is broken."
— Brannoc Ironvein [ch 001 / moment]

## Last Observed State

As of chapter 002 the forge is still cold. [ch 002 / 002.02]

## Secrets
The apprentice never left of his own will. CANARY-SECRET-7f3a
